caption: Boiling water is poured over a tea bag in a glass, and steam rises while the colour spreads from the bag.

sa.check: A tea bag sits in a glass.
Boiling water is poured over the bag.
Colour spreads from the bag into the water.
The bag stays in the glass.
The pour comes first and the colouring follows.

pc.expect: The water falls downward into the glass and the steam rises from it, while the colour sinks and spreads through the water.
pc.fail: The water travels upward from the kettle; or the steam sinks over the glass's rim and pools; or the colour climbs out of the water; or the steam pours downward from the spout.

pc.expect: The water only grows more coloured while the bag sits in it and the colour does not gather back into the bag.
pc.fail: The water clears again while the bag stays in it; or the colour draws back into the bag; or the water darkens and lightens in turn; or the water is dark before the bag is in it.

pc.expect: The colour comes out of the bag: it streams from where the bag sits and the water near it darkens first.
pc.fail: The water darkens evenly all over before any colour leaves the bag; or colour appears at the far side of the glass with none spreading from the bag; or the bag sits in hot water and the water stays clear to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: The bag is a limp paper pouch that swells and sinks and sheds colour, and the water is a thin liquid that swirls and finds its level.
pc.fail: The bag stays a rigid flat packet in the water; or the bag dissolves away into the water; or the water stands in a heap above the rim; or the colour moves as a solid mass through the water.

pc.expect: One bag in one glass; the bag stays whole and the water comes only from the pour.
pc.fail: The bag vanishes; or a second bag appears; or the bag passes through the glass's wall; or the water's level jumps with nothing poured.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The glass, the bag's tag and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The glass changes shape; or the tag changes; or items on the counter rearrange.
